items.name: Mountain Pose
items.description: A standing pose with the feet grounded, the spine comfortably upright, and the arms resting alongside the body.

items.name: Raised Arms Pose
items.description: A standing shape that lengthens upward while keeping the feet steady and the shoulders relaxed.

items.name: Standing Forward Fold
items.description: A forward-folding shape from standing, practised with softly bent knees when that feels more comfortable.

items.name: Halfway Lift
items.description: A partial lift from a forward fold that encourages a long, neutral back and a steady gaze toward the floor.

items.name: Chair Pose
items.description: A standing pose with bent knees and the hips moving back as though approaching a chair.

items.name: Warrior I
items.description: A split-stance standing pose with the front knee bent and the torso facing generally forward.

items.name: Warrior II
items.description: A wide standing pose with one knee bent and the arms reaching in opposite directions.

items.name: Reverse Warrior
items.description: A side-reaching variation from Warrior II with the front knee remaining comfortably bent.

items.name: Extended Side Angle
items.description: A wide stance with one knee bent and the torso lengthening diagonally over the front leg.

items.name: Triangle Pose
items.description: A wide-legged standing pose with straight legs and the torso extending to one side.

items.name: Wide-Legged Forward Fold
items.description: A forward fold from a wide stance, keeping the movement comfortable and unforced.

items.name: Tree Pose
items.description: A one-leg balance with the other foot resting below or above the standing knee, never directly on it.

items.name: Eagle Pose
items.description: A standing balance that layers crossed arms and legs; a simplified toe-down variation may be used.

items.name: Dancer Pose
items.description: A standing balance holding one lifted foot behind the body while maintaining a steady, comfortable shape.

items.name: Downward-Facing Dog
items.description: An inverted V-shaped pose supported by the hands and feet, with the knees bent as needed.

items.name: Plank Pose
items.description: A straight, supported shape from shoulders to heels, with knees lowered as an accessible option.

items.name: Knees-Chest-Chin Pose
items.description: A supported floor transition with knees down and the upper body lowered with control.

items.name: Cobra Pose
items.description: A gentle prone backbend with the hands supporting lightly and the chest lifting only to a comfortable height.

items.name: Sphinx Pose
items.description: A mild prone backbend supported on the forearms with the shoulders kept away from the ears.

items.name: Bridge Pose
items.description: A reclined pose with bent knees and the hips lifting to a comfortable height.

items.name: Staff Pose
items.description: A seated upright position with the legs extended and the hands resting beside the hips.

items.name: Easy Pose
items.description: A comfortable cross-legged seat that may be supported with a folded blanket or cushion.

items.name: Bound Angle Pose
items.description: A seated shape with the soles of the feet together and the knees opening only as far as comfortable.

items.name: Seated Forward Fold
items.description: A seated fold over extended legs, approached with bent knees and without forcing the reach.

items.name: Head-to-Knee Pose
items.description: A seated forward fold over one extended leg with the other knee comfortably bent.

items.name: Seated Spinal Twist
items.description: A gentle seated rotation performed with an upright spine and without pulling into the twist.

items.name: Cat Pose
items.description: A hands-and-knees shape that rounds the back gently while keeping the movement smooth.

items.name: Cow Pose
items.description: A hands-and-knees shape that gently opens the chest while maintaining a comfortable neck position.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.description: A resting kneeling shape with the torso supported toward the thighs and arms placed comfortably.

items.name: Corpse Pose
items.description: A quiet resting pose lying on the back with the body supported and relaxed.
